title: Eye test for glasses
what: The doctor checks your vision and finds the lenses that let you see clearly and comfortably. You get a glasses prescription.
why: When it has become harder to see far or close, your eyes get tired, or you get headaches when reading.
duration: usually 20 to 40 minutes; you get the prescription right away
tell_doctor: What you need glasses for: driving, computer work, reading
If you wore glasses or contacts before
Eye conditions, diabetes, high blood pressure

prepare.title: Contacts
prepare.text: If you wear contact lenses, you usually take them out beforehand. Ask the clinic how many hours before.

prepare.title: Rest
prepare.text: Try not to come right after long screen time.

bring: Your old glasses prescription, if you have it
steps: A machine measures how the eye focuses, without touching it
You read a letter chart with each eye
You wear a trial frame, and lenses are swapped
You say which lenses look clearer
Close-up vision is checked, if needed
The doctor examines your eyes and writes the prescription
feel: Sometimes it is hard to choose which lens is better. That is normal. Just say what you see
after: Take the prescription to an optician
New glasses usually take a few days to get used to
If they still feel wrong after 1 to 2 weeks, go back to the doctor
red_flags: Vision suddenly gets worse, or you see flashes, spots, or a curtain over the eye: see an eye doctor urgently

faq.q: Can I buy glasses without a test?
faq.a: Ready-made glasses do not account for differences between your eyes and other details. It is better to have them fitted.

faq.q: How often should I have my eyes checked?
faq.a: Usually every 1 to 2 years, or as your doctor says.

faq.q: Why do I feel dizzy in new glasses?
faq.a: Your eyes need time to adjust. It usually takes a few days.

reminders.text: Eye test for glasses in 2 hours. Bring your old glasses.
